channel.title: Open Source 3D & VFX Gems
channel.description: Open source 3D, VFX and video watch.

item.title: SuperSplat for Blender 0.1.0
item.description: SuperSplat for Blender 0.1.0 (5 Nov 2026): MIT PlayCanvas extension for Blender 5.3+ — import a SuperSplat scene by link (SOG/SSOG, attribution) and publish a selected splat back.

item.title: OM3D Atlas 0.4.3
item.description: OM3D Atlas 0.4.3 (6 Nov 2026): GPL extension that packs a character’s texture sets into atlases (texel density, UDIM, Max Sets); Revert now also deletes the generated textures.

item.title: Mat-Baker 1.1.0
item.description: Mat-Baker 1.1.0 (4 Nov 2026): GPL Blender 4.2+ add-on that bakes a procedural Principled BSDF material into a PBR pack in one click (Unreal/Unity/glTF presets, ORM, batch).

item.title: Paint a plate 1.11.1
item.description: Paint a plate 1.11.1 (3 Nov 2026): Apache-2.0 ComfyUI pack (AInVFX) to paint on a plate’s first frame (erase, add, relight); edits propagate through the shot, EXR/OCIO export.

item.title: Maya Scene IO 1.1.0
item.description: Maya Scene IO 1.1.0 (4 Nov 2026): import/export .ma/.mb in Blender without Maya; 1.1 fixes Maya matrices/pivots, animation tangents, units and animated groups.

item.title: OpenFilmic 1.0.0
item.description: OpenFilmic 1.0.0 (5 Nov 2026): a GPL Blender 5.2+ Compositor node packing film emulations, lens effects, animated grain and borders — 28 presets included.

item.title: CurioMesh 0.9.6
item.description: CurioMesh 0.9.6 (5 Nov 2026): free GPL auto-retopo for Blender 3.6–5.2 — all-quads part by part with camera checks; Texture Sets bake across multiple atlases.

item.title: StableGen 0.5.0
item.description: StableGen 0.5.0 (4 Nov 2026): GPL Blender add-on for AI texturing/generation via ComfyUI installable inside Blender, consistent multi-view projection, LATO.2 remesh and Make Solid.

item.title: OGC 3D Tiles Streaming 0.5.1
item.description: OGC 3D Tiles Streaming 0.5.1 (4 Nov 2026): MIT Blender add-on (Iconem) streaming meshes, point clouds and KHR Gaussian splats via cesium-native, with clips and overlays, EEVEE/Cycles.

item.title: splat2stl
item.description: splat2stl (repo dated 1 Nov 2026): MIT tool turning a Gaussian splat .ply into a watertight STL plus colored OBJ via pure-PyTorch silhouette carving, ~10 s on an 8 GB GPU.

item.title: Blender 5.3 — native Gaussian splats
item.description: Blender developers' post from Oct 30, 2026: 5.3 imports Gaussian splats (.ply, .spz, USD) as a point cloud type, editable in Geometry Nodes and rendered by EEVEE, Workbench and Cycles, with relighting still experimental.

item.title: Spirula Render 0.13.1
item.description: GPL render engine for Blender 5.3+ that renders Gaussian splats with Spirula Studio's rasterizer, with relighting and splat-to-splat shadows. Versions 0.11 to 0.13 (Nov 3, 2026) add flares, filters and vintage lenses from Vintage Click.

item.title: Photocraft VFX 0.4.0
item.description: Apache-2.0 layer-based image editor built like Nuke: 32-bit scene-linear ACEScg, OpenColorIO, multichannel EXR export and Nuke script output. 0.4.0 (Nov 4, 2026) adds a Nuke-style OCIO viewer, viewer LUTs and an input colour space setting.

item.title: Unity Gaussian Splatting 2.0.0
item.description: Aras Pranckevičius's MIT plugin for rendering Gaussian splats in Unity. 2.0.0 (Nov 2, 2026) loads .ply and .spz files (including SPZ 4) directly with no conversion, sorts several intersecting splats globally and drops the editing tools.

item.title: SimpleStep Importer 1.5.3
item.description: GPL add-on (Nov 2, 2026) that imports STEP CAD assemblies into Blender 5.2+ without freezing the UI: background C++ conversion, part names and hierarchy, instances, colours and adaptive meshing. Windows x64 only for now.

item.title: SplatThumb 0.4.0
item.description: MIT tool for Windows 10/11 that shows Explorer thumbnails for Gaussian splat .ply files (INRIA and SuperSplat compressed PLY), with an adjustable view per file. Version 0.4.0, Nov 1, 2026.

item.title: Perspective Match 1.0.1
item.description: GPL extension for Blender 5.2 released Nov 1, 2026: draw perspective lines on a photo and the camera solves live (auto line detection on architecture), handy for matching 3D into a still plate.

item.title: Devil Designer 0.11.0
item.description: GPL add-on for making clothes in Blender: 2D patterns in centimetres, sewing, then draping on the character with cloth simulation. Version 0.11.0 (Oct 31, 2026) adds calibrated fabric presets and per-piece settings.

item.title: Sabercat 1.0.0
item.description: Apache-2.0 GPU engine for Gaussian splats (Vulkan 1.3, Slang/C++): real-time rendering, gradients for training and relighting with ray-traced shadows, plus a viewer and a layer editor with PLY/GLB export. Version 1.0.0, Oct 29, 2026.

item.title: PlayCanvas — Particle Blast (splats)
item.description: New example in the MIT PlayCanvas engine (added Nov 2, 2026): a Gaussian splat scene turns into 2 million WebGPU physics particles that burn, pour or shatter, colliding with a voxel grid derived from the splat.

item.title: Gaussian-Splat-Lite
item.description: Apache-2.0 Gaussian splat renderer for Three.js (WebGPU/WebGL2, PLY, SPZ, SOG, RAD, streaming LOD). Since Nov 2, 2026 its RAD converter supports an SH codebook, making SH3 files over 55% smaller.

item.title: Image Region Transform 1.0.4
item.description: GPL add-on that selects a pixel region in the Image/UV Editor (box or polyline) to move, rotate, warp or copy it across textures, without touching UVs and with native undo. Version 1.0.4 released Nov 1, 2026.

item.title: EasyMold 1.0.1
item.description: Free add-on that builds 3D-printable molds around an object: direct or silicone molds, parting surface, keys, pour holes, vents, splitting for the print bed and STL/3MF export. Published Oct 30, 2026.

item.title: Arkedia SKP Bridge 0.3.3
item.description: GPL Blender extension that imports and exports SketchUp .skp files without SketchUp: components as instances, tags as collections, scenes as cameras, and Bonsai IFC attributes kept. Windows, Blender 5.2. Version 0.3.3 released Oct 30, 2026.

item.title: Fused Zip-NeRF
item.description: MIT reimplementation of Zip-NeRF in handwritten fused CUDA kernels for the NeRFICG framework: per author Florian Hahlbohm, 6 to 7 times faster training and 10 times faster rendering at the same quality. Released Oct 30, 2026.

item.title: Ucupaint 3.0
item.description: Blender’s GPL texture layer system skips 2.5: a UI centred on the layer list with a base layer, separate Height and Vector Displacement channels, adjustment layers, spherical and cylindrical decals, and a reworked bake target system. Released Oct 23, 2026.

item.title: Ichno 1.0.4
item.description: GPL extension that turns your scene into PDF/SVG technical drawings in one click: projected and isometric views, automatic dimensions, title block, bill of materials, one sheet per collection. Version 1.0.4 (Oct 31, 2026) puts each drawing in its own folder.

item.title: Black Hole Studio 1.0.0
item.description: GPL extension that adds a physically based black hole: light bent by general relativity, accretion disk with Doppler beaming and redshift, jets, scene objects lensed behind it. Fast mode for Cycles/EEVEE or exact OSL mode, six presets. Published Oct 28, 2026.

item.title: PlateLock
item.description: MIT ComfyUI node pack: LTX-2.3 generates the effect (explosion, portal…) and PlateLock composites it onto the original plate the VFX way, keeping every pixel the effect doesn’t touch bit-identical. Published Oct 29, 2026.

item.title: noodlebin 0.1.1
item.description: GPL extension that copies Blender node trees (shader, Geometry Nodes, compositor) as text: paste them on noodlebin.art to view and share as a link, then paste them back into any .blend with values, frames and groups intact. Published Oct 25, 2026.

item.title: Origa 0.4.0
item.description: GPL add-on that turns a plane into paper: fold, roll, curl, wave, tear or crumple it with simple sliders, with presets (bills, receipts, scrolls) and one-click money rain. Published Oct 28, 2026.

item.title: OM3D Asset Prep 0.6.5
item.description: GPL Blender add-on that takes a game asset from messy import to baked and exported: scene checks and fixes (transforms, n-gons, normals, UVs), low/high pairing for baking and per-asset FBX export for Unreal, Substance or Marmoset. v0.6.5, Oct 29, 2026.

item.title: Idol (Speridlabs)
item.description: Apache-2.0 code that generates a Gaussian splat object (3DGS .ply, up to ~1M Gaussians, unseen sides included) from a single image on consumer GPUs (~7 GB VRAM). Released Oct 28, 2026, already with a LichtFeld Studio plugin.

item.title: Material Maker 1.8
item.description: Open-source (MIT) node-based procedural material editor, a free alternative to Substance Designer. Version 1.8 (Oct 25, 2026) adds a Trimsheet node, an Auto Export node that re-exports on every change, a high-quality Gaussian blur and a Crop node.

item.title: Blender Max 0.6.8
item.description: GPL add-on that dresses Blender like 3ds Max: Command Panel, modifier stack, quad menus, Scene Explorer and parametric primitives, with one-click return to Blender's own UI. Version 0.6.8 (Oct 24, 2026) draws lights the way Max does.

item.title: SpEdE (Splat Edit Engine)
item.description: Open-source (AGPL) ComfyUI nodes released Oct 28, 2026 for editing Gaussian-splat scenes: click an object to remove it (the hole is refilled with new splats), extract it as a clean PLY or replace it. Everything runs locally on your own GPU.

item.title: LiveActionAOV 0.9.0
item.description: Open-source (MIT) AOV pass generator for live-action plates: depth, normals, flow, mattes as Nuke-ready EXRs. Version 0.9.0 (Oct 28, 2026) adds camera tracking, a Gaussian-splat clean plate, layered roto and an auto-generated .nk comp script.

item.title: pynk_p Smoothing Groups 1.0.1
item.description: Blender add-on (GPL) bringing 3ds Max-style 30 smoothing groups: toggle-button assignment, auto by angle, and non-destructive subdivision that keeps hard edges via Geometry Nodes. Published on Blender Extensions in late Oct 2026.

item.title: MP_Comp 4.0.1
item.description: CC0 library of 100+ procedural effects for Blender's compositor, built as node groups with no add-on needed. Version 4.0.1 (Oct 11, 2026) makes them usable as Scene Effects in Blender 5.3's new compositor stack, while staying 5.2 LTS compatible.

item.title: Nukify 0.9.2
item.description: Open-source (GPL) node-based compositor for Windows that uses a bundled Blender as its engine: A/B viewer, roto, keying, 2D and planar tracking, 3D nodes, EXR/Cryptomatte output. First public beta released Oct 28, 2026.

item.title: Quadami 0.1.0
item.description: GPL Blender add-on for automatic quad remeshing, derived from AutoRemesher: pick a quad count and it turns a sculpt or scan into a clean mesh with edge loops that follow the shape. First public release on Oct 27, 2026.

item.title: ProxyWrangler 1.1.1
item.description: GPL Blender extension for laying out heavy environments: it swaps assets for lightweight silhouette proxies, handles linked assets and overrides, then restores production geometry for rendering. New on Blender Extensions on Oct 25, 2026.

item.title: AnyImage 1.1.7
item.description: GPL Blender add-on that starts from images: paste from the clipboard, cut out shapes with thickness, depth planes, texture rectify and color match, plus offline AI background removal and upscaling. Version 1.1.7 released Oct 25, 2026.

item.title: Croquis 0.4.1
item.description: GPL Blender extension that draws the camera view as an architect’s freehand sketch: ink, marker, watercolour, hatching, a choice of paper, and PNG, layered SVG or PDF output. New on Blender Extensions on Oct 21, 2026.

item.title: Maya Workflow Kit for Blender 0.5.0
item.description: GPL Blender extension for Maya users: hotbox and marking menus, Channel Box, Attribute Editor, shelves, Maya-style navigation, Freeze Transformations, Delete History… One switch gives plain Blender back. Published on Blender Extensions on Oct 20, 2026.

item.title: Gaussian Splat to Blender Nodes
item.description: MIT toolkit (agent skill, scripts and prompts) released Oct 24, 2026 that rebuilds a Gaussian Splat capture as real, editable Blender geometry with Geometry Nodes and Shader Nodes, plus optional multi-view texture projection.

item.title: NK Combine & Bake 1.0.0
item.description: GPL Blender extension that merges selected objects, builds a UV atlas and bakes their materials (base color, metallic, roughness, normal, emission, alpha) into textures up to 8K with Cycles. New on Blender Extensions in Oct 2026.

item.title: First Person Navigation 1.1.1
item.description: GPL Blender extension adding Unreal-style first-person viewport navigation: right-click + WASD, panning, camera smoothing and configurable keys. v1.1.1 (Oct 26, 2026) adds up/down movement with Q and E.

item.title: colmap-wasm
item.description: Unofficial WebAssembly port of COLMAP 4.2.1 (BSD-3), released Oct 19, 2026: SIFT extraction, WebGPU matching and the global mapper run in the browser with no server, giving cameras and a sparse point cloud for photogrammetry or splat captures.

item.title: SculptForge 0.6.0
item.description: GPL sculpting app for Linux, macOS and Windows, built as a free alternative to ZBrush. Version 0.5 (Oct 24, 2026) adds subdivision levels (multiresolution) and 0.6, out the same day, nearly halves memory use on heavy models.

item.title: Splatelier v0.1.0
item.description: Apache-2.0 iOS app that captures, trains and views Gaussian Splats entirely on the iPhone, with no server. The Oct 24, 2026 v0.1.0 reworks the capture screen, adds more export formats and an experimental LiDAR mode.

item.title: Viewport Rulers 1.1.0
item.description: Small GPL extension for Blender 5.2+ published on Oct 22, 2026: it adds configurable Word-style rulers along the edges of the 3D viewport, handy in orthographic view to measure without switching to the Measure tool.

item.title: 3D Cursor Transform 1.0.0
item.description: GPL extension published on Oct 18, 2026 that gives Blender's 3D Cursor the full native transform system: G/R shortcuts, gizmos, axis and plane constraints, snapping, precision mode and numeric input.

item.title: Papercraft Pro
item.description: New GPL extension for Blender 4.2+ shared on Oct 24, 2026: it unfolds a mesh into a papercraft pattern with glue tabs, live page layout, Cricut-ready SVG export and an animated rig that folds the sheet back onto the model.

item.title: Spirula Studio v2026.10.16
item.description: Cross-vendor Gaussian Splatting trainer (Vulkan or CUDA), from video to splat to mesh. The Oct 16, 2026 release cuts RAM/VRAM use, adds dense initialization and spherical beta, and handles log and 360 footage better.

item.title: ID RenderFlo 3.0.0
item.description: Blender add-on that brings a KeyShot-style render studio and a CAD pipeline for industrial designers. Listed on Blender Extensions on Oct 14, 2026, it moved to version 3.0.0 this week.

item.title: Blender 5.2.3 LTS and 4.5.15 LTS
item.description: Two corrective LTS releases out on Oct 22, 2026: Blender 5.2.3 fixes 113 bugs and Blender 4.5.15 fixes 60. Full changelog on the LTS page.

item.title: CorridorKey 2.0
item.description: Corridor Digital publishes the Python code and model for CorridorKey 2.0, for clean green/blue screen keys (NVIDIA GPU required). CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 license with extra terms, so not strictly open source; repo updated Oct 15, 2026.

item.title: DL GIS Exchange 1.0.0
item.description: GPL Blender extension released Oct 22, 2026: imports GeoTIFF/ASC/XYZ terrain and shapefile/GeoPackage/GeoJSON vectors, exports back to GeoTIFF, and computes cut and fill. No GDAL or QGIS needed.

item.title: Tree Wind Paint 0.3.4
item.description: GPL Blender add-on that auto-paints wind vertex colours on a tree from its structure (trunk, branches, leaves), with per-channel or UV touch-ups and a wind preview. New on Blender Extensions (spotted Oct 23, 2026).

item.title: Stepped Animation 1.0.0
item.description: Blender 5.2 extension that turns smooth interpolated animation into stop-motion style stepped animation on 2s, 3s or 4s. New on Blender Extensions (spotted Oct 23, 2026).

item.title: Blender on Android — demo APK (BCON26)
item.description: On Oct 21, 2026 Blender shared the Blender on Android project presentation shown at BCON26, along with a downloadable demo APK to try the current state of the tablet port.

item.title: Holey Tools 1.0.0
item.description: GPL Blender extension for precise work on mesh holes: Resize Hole sets a cylindrical or conical bore to an exact diameter, Fair Hole fills it cleanly. The Oct 22, 2026 update handles difficult cases much better.

item.title: Unravel 1.0.0
item.description: Geometry Nodes extension for Blender 5.2: paint tears onto cloth and holes open with thick edges and frayed threads (8 presets: denim, linen, silk…), ready for simulation and export. Released Oct 19, 2026.

item.title: EasyBones 0.3.0
item.description: GPL Blender extension to place bones from a vertex selection without leaving mesh edit mode: New, Extend, Span (a bone through a cylinder), Shift+Alt+B pie menu. Published Oct 19, 2026.

item.title: athenea 0.3.0
item.description: Apache-2.0 engine (Slang + Hydra delegate) that turns USD assets into Gaussian splats you can relight under any sky. v0.3.0 on Oct 19, 2026 ships for macOS, Linux and Windows with a Blender add-on; a Nuke/Natron OFX node is coming.

item.title: OOOSplat 0.7.0
item.description: Apache-2.0 desktop app (Windows, macOS, Linux) that turns a video or image sequence into Gaussian Splats in one click, fully local (COLMAP + Brush). v0.7.0 on Oct 19, 2026 adds 360° video, PLY/SOG/SPZ import and multi-format export.

item.title: Maya Workflow Kit for Blender 0.2.0
item.description: GPL Blender extension that gives Maya users their bearings back: hotbox and marking menus, Channel Box, Attribute Editor, shelves, Freeze/Delete History. One switch restores stock Blender. First public release on Oct 20, 2026.

item.title: In-Place Animation Tool 1.0.1
item.description: GPL Blender extension that turns root-motion animations (Mixamo, Cascadeur, mocap, Rigify) into in-place cycles without feet sinking, keeping jumps and sway, and can extract a root bone for game engines. v1.0.1 on Oct 19, 2026.

item.title: FBX Scale Report 0.1.2
item.description: GPL Blender extension (also a command-line tool) that reads a folder of FBX files without importing them and reports each file’s declared unit scale and the tool that wrote it, with CSV and HTML reports. No more 100× oversized models. Released Oct 15, 2026.

item.title: Photonsmith 0.1.4
item.description: MIT pbrt-v4-compatible path tracer with CPU, OptiX and Metal backends, a Qt GUI, a Scene Builder and a live preview where you can drag objects; its renders are checked against closed-form results. Shown on Oct 21, 2026; v0.1.4 from Oct 15.

item.title: RealIndex 1.1.0
item.description: GPL Blender 5.2 extension that turns a folder into a live asset library: drop in a Sketchfab model, an ambientCG or Poly Haven texture or an HDRI (zipped or not) and it shows up in the Asset Browser with a thumbnail, no manual import. v1.1.0 on Oct 17, 2026.

item.title: c4-operator 0.1
item.description: Apache-2.0 Kubernetes operator from Avalanche-io that turns a cluster into one farm for rendering, CI and ML: files addressed by C4 ID (SMPTE ST 2114), a queue ordered by deadlines instead of priorities, versioned outputs, a HUD and an MCP server. v0.1, published Oct 16, 2026.

item.title: B-Bone Gizmos 1.0.0
item.description: GPL Blender extension by Tal Hershkovich, extracted from AnimToolbox: a Pose Mode gizmo tool to shape bendy bones like Bézier handles (location, rotation, scale). Cited at the Oct 15, 2026 Animation & Rigging meeting as a reference for a native version.

item.title: E3D Bridge 0.3.2
item.description: GPL Blender add-on that exports a scene to Element 3D (After Effects) in one click: OBJ + MTL with the right slots, converted Principled textures (roughness to glossiness, bump to normal), smart decimation of heavy CAD meshes and a detailed report. First release on Oct 5, 2026.

item.title: UV Island Colorizer 1.0.0
item.description: GPL Blender add-on that gives every UV island a random color to check a layout at a glance, and can bake a PNG color ID map from 64 to 8192 px with Cycles, per mesh, selection or whole collection. Published Oct 10, 2026.

item.title: PolySketch 1.0.0
item.description: GPL Blender add-on for CAD-style drafting: 2D sketching on faces or workplanes with snapping (vertex, midpoint, perpendicular), face cutting along a polyline and exact mitred offsets with units (100mm, 2'6"). Released on Oct 11, 2026.

item.title: Auto Pivot Baker 1.0.2
item.description: GPL Blender add-on that merges a collection of objects into one mesh while storing each piece's pivot in UVs, so the parts can be animated by shader in Unreal or Unity. Sample projects included; v1.0.2 on Oct 14, 2026.

item.title: MatteDesk 0.32
item.description: Local GPL tool for VFX roto and mattes in the browser: describe or click the object, SAM3, CoTracker3 and MatAnyone2 compute the mask for the whole shot, and you only fix the bad frames. Export to Nuke/After Effects. v0.32 on Oct 18, 2026.

item.title: RenderMesh 0.3.0
item.description: Serverless Blender render farm for Windows PCs on a local network (C++, Apache 2.0): idle machines pick up batches of Eevee or Cycles frames, the project is transferred and outputs are brought back. JSON CLI included. v0.3.0 on Oct 16, 2026.

item.title: babalon JS 1.0.1
item.description: GPL 3D scene composer in the browser (Babylon.js, offline PWA): import glb/fbx, place with Blender-style shortcuts, light, pose or auto-rig, then use a video-game photo mode and AR. v1.0.1 on Oct 16, 2026.

item.title: Loop Resample 1.0.1
item.description: GPL Blender add-on: select edges and change their segment count with the mouse wheel while keeping UVs, seams, sharp edges and vertex colours. Shift smooths the curve, Ctrl spaces points evenly. Released on Oct 11, 2026, already close to 900 downloads.

item.title: Mesh XR 0.6.4
item.description: GPL Blender add-on for modelling in VR through OpenXR: one controller selects and moves objects or faces, the other holds a tool menu (extrude, bevel, inset, materials, UVs). Released on Oct 9, 2026; v0.6.5 on GitHub on Oct 17.

item.title: Blender — Straight Skeleton node (WIP)
item.description: PR by Howard Trickey: a “Straight Skeleton” Geometry Nodes node that makes mitred-offset-style insets/outsets on curves, meshes or Grease Pencil, handling overlaps, with multiple segments. “Closer to mergeable” per the Oct 12, 2026 meeting.

item.title: AYON Core 1.10
item.description: The open-source AYON pipeline (OpenPype’s successor) adds a Lists category to its Browser: entity lists and review sessions grouped in folders, to filter versions of a shot or task. 1.10.0 on Oct 7, 2026, 1.10.1 fix on Oct 13.

item.title: SMIRK 1.0.1
item.description: GPL Blender add-on (5.2+) for carving mouths, eyes and other stylised openings into a mesh from an edge loop, a ribbon or Grease Pencil — the “boolean mouth”, built for production. Released on Oct 13, 2026.

item.title: Texture Wrangler 1.0.0
item.description: GPL Blender add-on that detects every map (normal, roughness, AO…) whatever its naming, then copies and renames the textures into clean per-material folders without touching the originals. Released on Oct 11, 2026.

item.title: LichtFeld Studio 0.5.4
item.description: The GPL app for training and editing Gaussian Splats adds a project manager, an online gallery, headless rendering of camera paths and 16-bit HDR training, with less VRAM. Released on Oct 9, 2026.

item.title: natron-mcp
item.description: Python MCP server (GPL-2) that lets an AI agent drive Natron: node graph, parameters, keyframes, rendering, headless sessions. Designed for Niik-l’s Natron 3D 2.6 fork; repo created on Oct 12, 2026.

item.title: Blender — LoopTools now native
item.description: The Oct 12, 2026 Modeling meeting announces the end of the migration of LoopTools to native Blender tools; an open PR adds them to the Edit Mode context menu.

item.title: Dolly Zoom 1.0.0
item.description: GPL Blender add-on (4.2+): a dolly zoom (Hitchcock effect) slider for the viewport and the camera — focal length and movement linked, pivoting on the 3D cursor. First version, 1.0.0, released on Oct 11, 2026.

item.title: Minimalist Pipeline 1.0.14
item.description: Lightweight file pipeline inside Blender (GPL): projects, versions, notes/retakes, read-only sessions and a render farm on a shared drive (local JSON). Version 1.0.14 (Oct 15) adds farm tracking to monitoring and sequence previews.

item.title: FreebirdCollabo 0.12.1
item.description: GPL Blender add-on (public alpha) for co-editing a scene in real time (objects, mesh, UVs, materials, pose…) via a Room Code; optional VR with Freebird XR. v0.12.1 (Oct 6) can update itself from the COLLAB panel.

item.title: OpenUTV 2026.13
item.description: OSS image/sequence player (Apache 2.0, OpenRV fork) for VFX review: EXR/DPX, OCIO, HDR. Version 2026.13 (Oct 11) makes image sequences much faster and adds hover preview on the timeline.

item.title: Hardcraft 0.10.0-alpha
item.description: CAD retopology add-on for Blender (Plasticity/STEP/OBJ). 0.10.0-alpha (Oct 14) adds De-feature (pockets/bosses), cappers built into the topology (curved faces included), curve Join and selection by CAD continuity.

item.title: Synth Surface
item.description: GPL Blender add-on: procedural greeble textures (color/displacement) and scatter lights, a fork of Displacement X, usable directly in Blender. Presented on r/blender in late September 2026.

item.title: Open Painter 0.15.1
item.description: Non-destructive PBR texturing in Blender 5.2+ (GPL): texture sets, paint and fill layers, masks, mesh map baking, 50 smart materials, UDIM and export. Version 0.15.1 released on Oct 14.

item.title: Render Unique Frames 0.2.2
item.description: Blender add-on that spots identical frames in an animation (objects, compositor, view layers) and renders only the unique ones: ideal for animation on twos or threes and large static sets. Headless command-line rendering. Version 0.2.2 (Oct 13).

item.title: Preview Quads 1.0.0
item.description: Blender add-on that previews live, without touching the mesh, the triangles-to-quads conversion (same algorithm as Blender) with all its settings, then applies it in one click. Handy after a CAD import or booleans. Released on Oct 12.

item.title: Gausify Orbit 0.5.0
item.description: Free app (MIT) that turns an orbit video, even an AI-generated one, into a Gaussian Splat, 100% locally: macOS/Windows desktop or a WebGPU version in the browser. Version 0.5.0 (Oct 13).
